    Transfer: representation-finiteness passes to the linearization of the ray category #

    For split basic data S of a distributive representation-finite algebra B, the linearization of the (small) ray category of B is representation-finite (SplitBasicData.isRepresentationFinite_linearization). This is Bretscher–Gabriel's theorem; the proof uses the multiplicative-bases library: B is presented by the ray table of its graded standard form A₀ (rayA_eq_rayA0), which is representation-finite, and also by the ray table of its ray category (isRayPres_linTable); two presentations have isomorphic tables.

    ψ.symm (F'.e j) = F.e (σ.symm j)

    A table presenting a representation-finite basic algebra has a representation-finite linearization (compare with the table of A₀).

    Bretscher–Gabriel: the linearization of the ray category of a representation-finite distributive algebra is representation-finite.
